title: it may report that a bound is wrong and may never state the replacement
why: The Scoper's one unbreakable rule, arriving through a different door. Every correctly-performed job comes in just under the lower bound, which is strong evidence the figure is wrong — and the new figure still has to come from the shop. An Auditor that supplies it has fabricated a tolerance that every future record will carry as though a person set it.

steps.title: Check the pads before you touch anything
steps.explanation: If they are already past the limit the rest of the job changes.

fields.prompt: Measure the thinnest pad and enter it

steps.title: Clean the caliper up
steps.explanation: Contamination on the disc stops the job dead.

fields.prompt: Photograph the caliper once it is clean

steps.title: Fit the new pads and torque the caliper bolts
steps.explanation: An under-torqued caliper bolt backs out under braking heat.

fields.prompt: Torque both caliper bolts and record the reading
